en.meta.title: camsync: all your cameras, one vertical video
en.meta.description: camsync brings what your cameras see onto one screen and lets you decide how the vertical video is woven. Every camera keeps its full original. Today: one iPhone and one Mac.
en.diagram.label: Diagram: five sources converge on one vertical frame. Only the iPhone exists today.
en.src.titles: titles and graphics · not built yet
en.frame.caption: full original, uncropped
en.fig.chunks: pieces that reach the Mac while you record
en.intro.lede: camsync brings what your cameras see onto one screen and lets you decide how the vertical video is woven. Every camera keeps its full original. Today it works with one iPhone and one Mac.
en.run.label: With Node 22 or newer, from the cloned repository folder
en.today.title: The line that exists
en.today.lede: One iPhone and one Mac on the same local network. Nothing goes through a MADFAM server.
en.today.phone.title: On the iPhone
en.today.phone: A page in Safari uses the camera, records the full original in whichever orientation you hold the phone, and sends it to the Mac in one-second pieces.
en.today.net.title: Over the local network
en.today.net: The live view travels straight from the phone to the Mac. The Mac receives the original while you record.
en.today.mac.title: On the Mac
en.today.mac: You watch the take live, start and stop it, and choose the resolution, shape (16:9 or 4:3), lens and zoom.
en.measured.title: What we measured
en.measured.intro: Measured on 24 November 2026 with an iPhone 15.
en.measured.caption: Measured resolution and frames per second
en.measured.format: Originals are MP4 files with H.264 video and AAC sound.
en.measured.limit: We have measured it with that iPhone only. We do not know yet how it behaves on other models.
en.notyet.title: The lines that do not exist yet
en.notyet.intro: None of this is built. If you need it today, camsync does not have it.
en.notyet.titles: Titles and graphics over the video.
en.notyet.log: A record of every decision in the take, on the exact frame.
en.notyet.multi: Several cameras and screens at once.
en.notyet.render: The finished render on MADFAM's CEQ platform.
en.notyet.app: A native app: today everything runs in the browser.
en.use.title: How it is used today
en.use.1: Connect the Mac and the iPhone to the same local network.
en.use.2: On the Mac, from the cloned folder, start the studio:
en.use.3: Open the control panel on the Mac. It shows the address to open in Safari on the iPhone.
en.use.4: On the iPhone, allow the camera and the microphone. From the Mac you start and stop the take; the original is saved to a folder on the Mac.
en.use.cert: The first time, Safari warns that the Mac's certificate is self-signed. The Mac creates it when it starts, and it only works inside your local network.
en.use.source: The code is public. The studio runs only on your local network; it is not served from the internet.
en.foot.quiet: This page uses no cookies and no analytics, and it does not appear in search engines.
